Fuel50, an AI-powered workforce transformation platform.
Fuel50 provides workforce intelligence, talent marketplace and workforce planning tools to help companies manage changing skill requirements.
The acquisition aims to combine Fuel50’s workforce technology with Phoenix Education’s career-focused education and workforce development capabilities.
Fuel50 will continue operating under its own brand as a distinct business within Phoenix Education after the deal closes.
The transaction is expected to close within 30 days.
Jo Mills, Fuel50’s co-founder and president, is expected to become CEO of Fuel50 following the transaction.

title: Phoenix Education partners to acquire Fuel50
